The '''Players Committee''' (PC) is a volunteer community that has maintained organized play, virtual cards, and errata for Star Wars CCG after Decipher ended the game.

PC errata and virtual cards are documented here as a '''later, labeled layer''' &mdash; popular organized-play modifications of Decipher's game &mdash; not as "the card" replacing Decipher printings.

* '''Creators (Decipher era):''' [[Creators of SWCCG]]
* '''History:''' [[History of the Players Committee]]
* '''Early news desk:''' [[Game Players Network]]
* '''Decipher license end (2001):''' [[Decipher and the Star Wars CCG Lucasfilm license]]
* '''Players Committee&ndash;Lucasfilm agreement:''' [[Players Committee-Lucasfilm agreement]]
* '''V-slips / printable overlays:''' [[V-slips]]
* '''Pre-reorg Virtual Sets (2002-2009):''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Rules by era:''' [[Rulebooks]]
* '''Formats (Standard vs Legacy):''' [[Formats]]

Official PC organized play: [https://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org]
